summary: Iteration 23: Portfolio Analyze bug fix verified + Alert Sound upgrade confirmed. All 16 backend tests pass. Full frontend integration tested. One additional bug found and fixed: portfolio_risk_metrics was computed but not passed through in the API endpoint response builder (both manual and upload endpoints).

key_findings.portfolio_analyze_bug_fix: _get_fundamental_cached renamed to _get_fundamental_data is confirmed working. DMART and KAYNES now return HTTP 200 with stocks array and recommendation field.
key_findings.portfolio_risk_metrics_bug_fixed: Both analyze_portfolio_manual and analyze_portfolio_upload endpoints were creating PortfolioAnalyzeResponse without passing portfolio_risk_metrics=analysis.portfolio_risk_metrics and enhanced_analytics=analysis.enhanced_analytics. Fixed in /app/backend/server.py lines ~6339-6345 and ~6374-6382.
key_findings.alert_sound_upgrade: playAlertSound now supports 3 types: urgent (3 rapid 1100/900/1100 Hz square bursts), target (3 ascending 660/880/1100 Hz sine tones), warning (2 moderate 820 Hz triangle pulses). Alert monitor covers urgentAlertSet, targetStateSet, and warningAlertSet.
key_findings.fno_alert_description: Alert buzzer description reads: 'Alerts on: Urgent exits, T1/T2 target hits, and warnings — loud multi-tone sound.' Confirmed T1/T2 targets are explicitly mentioned.
key_findings.buzzer_toggle: Enable Alert Buzzer button (data-testid=enable-alert-buzzer-button) toggles to 'Buzzer Enabled' on click.
key_findings.dmart_result_screenshot: DMART portfolio shows WAIT & WATCH recommendation, LTP ₹4,551.30, all 6 horizons PROFIT, comments include Beneish M-Score analysis.
key_findings.sector_momentum_regression: GET /api/sector-momentum still returns 15 sectors — regression check passed.
key_findings.vol_bands_regression: INFY custom-search still returns vol_bands with all 6 keys (1W,1M,3M,6M,9M,1Y) — regression check passed.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: Both /api/portfolio/analyze and /api/portfolio/analyze-upload endpoints were not passing portfolio_risk_metrics and enhanced_analytics from the internal analysis object to the final API response. Fixed by adding portfolio_risk_metrics=analysis.portfolio_risk_metrics and enhanced_analytics=analysis.enhanced_analytics in both response constructors.
NOTE: KAYNES symbol was found by yfinance (returned stocks array, not in failed_symbols). Both DMART and KAYNES work correctly after _get_fundamental_cached → _get_fundamental_data rename fix.
NOTE: server.py is 6721 lines — still very large, recommend splitting into routers per domain.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (lines ~6339-6345 and ~6374-6382: added portfolio_risk_metrics and enhanced_analytics passthrough in both portfolio analyze endpoints)
